title: Parseval identity
statement: Let $F$ be a complex Fourier system on finite sets $Ω$ and $ι$, with a full-support probability law and an orthonormal basis containing the constant-one function at a distinguished index. For every complex-valued function $f$ on $Ω$, its probability-weighted squared norm equals the sum of the squared absolute values of its Fourier coefficients: $\langle f,f\rangle=\sum_{i\in ι}\overline{\widehat f(i)}\,\widehat f(i)$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a complex Fourier system on finite sets $Ω$ and $ι$
The probability law of $F$ has full support
The basis of $F$ is orthonormal and includes the constant-one function at its distinguished index
